主要内容: On September 13, 2016, Medallion Financial Corp, along with other entities, amended its Loan and Security Agreement as part of a broader financial restructuring effort. The amendment was executed in conjunction with an agreement between Taxi Medallion Loan Trust III, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp, and Autobahn Funding Company LLC and DZ Bank AG Deutsche Zentral-Genossenschaftsbank, Frankfurt am Main. The amendment was part of a broader financial restructuring initiative aimed at improving the company's financial position.
